# Pull request

## Related issue

Link the issue or explain why no issue exists.

## Scope

Describe the outcome included in this pull request.

## Non-goals

List adjacent work deliberately left out.

## Verification

List the exact commands run and their results. Include relevant target, feature,
browser, or platform limitations.

```text
command
result
```

## User-visible evidence

For UI changes, include before-and-after screenshots at relevant desktop and
mobile sizes. For non-UI changes, provide a minimal reproducible example or
explain why visual evidence does not apply.

## Compatibility and risk

Describe compatibility, migration, security, privacy, accessibility, data
retention, and rollback effects. State whether external behavior or public
contracts change.

## Checklist

- [ ] I linked the relevant issue or explained why none exists.
- [ ] The scope and non-goals are explicit.
- [ ] I added or updated outcome-focused tests where behavior changed.
- [ ] I recorded exact verification commands and results.
- [ ] I updated English and Chinese documentation together, or explained why
      no user-facing wording changed.
- [ ] I updated `CHANGELOG.md` for a notable change, or explained why it is not
      needed.
- [ ] I reviewed security, privacy, accessibility, and data-retention effects.
- [ ] I removed secrets, credentials, personal data, and proprietary fixtures.
- [ ] I included UI screenshots, or marked them not applicable with a reason.
- [ ] I documented compatibility, migration, deprecation, and rollback impact.
- [ ] I did not claim a release, deployment, stability level, remote setting,
      or Agent-callability without evidence.
- [ ] All required checks pass and review conversations are resolved before
      merge.
